facebookresearch_theseus/theseus/_versio.test_lt_version: test the lt_version function with various version string pairs to verify correct comparison logic

facebookresearch_theseus/theseus/global_.check_dtype_supported: check whether a given torch dtype is supported by Theseus (float32 or float64 only)
facebookresearch_theseus/theseus/global_.configure_approx_jacobians: configure the fast_approx_local_jacobians flag to enable or disable fast approximate local Jacobian computation
